fields.name: Swaravoski Green
fields.description: Every detail bears the hand of a master artisan: embroidery drawn like lace, sequins that catch the faintest light, crystals that whisper of refinement. The flowing lines embrace the body with effortless grace, while the sculpted belt brings poise and balance. Wide sleeves fall like silk poetry, echoing Morocco’s heritage of royal attire.

fields.name: Golden Heirloom
fields.description: A majestic statement of opulence and heritage, Crimson Majesty wraps the wearer in a story woven from gold and fire. The deep black base is boldly adorned with red and golden motifs, recalling the imperial art of Moroccan weaving. Designed for the woman who commands presence without raising her voice.

fields.name: Jellaba Golden Dusk
fields.description: Jellaba Golden Dusk is a masterpiece of subtle grandeur. Crafted in textured jacquard with refined tonal embroidery, this djellaba evokes the richness of Moroccan craftsmanship through its intricate geometric detailing and luxurious finish. The warm golden hue flatters every complexion and adds a serene, noble aura—perfect for refined Ramadan evenings or elegant daytime occasions. A timeless piece for the woman who moves with quiet strength and grace.

fields.name: Kimono Whispers
